csv_project_name: consultant for Restroom and Waste Infrastructure Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The Visit Leadville-Twin Lakes Tourism Panel, in partnership with Lake County Government, is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced consultants to develop a comprehensive strategic plan addressing restroom and waste infrastructure in and around Twin Lakes. This ePort will support destination stewardship, environmental protection, and sustainable tourism management by identifying practical, long-term solutions to sanitation and waste challenges. The resulting plan will guide future investments, improve the visitor experience, and help preserve the natural beauty and community character of the Twin Lakes area.
csv_disciplines_requested: Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Site Evaluation/Selection, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Hazardous Waste Engineering

title: Consultant for Restroom and Waste Infrastructure Plan
short_description: Strategic plan for restroom and waste infrastructure in the Twin Lakes tourism area.
project_location: Twin Lakes and Leadville, Lake County, Colorado, USA
project_scope: Development of a comprehensive strategic plan for restroom and waste infrastructure in and around Twin Lakes to support destination stewardship, environmental protection, and sustainable tourism management. The plan is intended to identify practical long-term sanitation and waste solutions, guide future investments, improve visitor experience, and preserve the natural environment and community character. No building size, area, or structural technical characteristics are stated.
services: Consulting services for strategic planning, including surveying/GIS/mapping, site evaluation/selection, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, and hazardous waste engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure planning and environmental/infrastructure strategy project without structural or building design scope.
- Focus is restroom and waste infrastructure planning, not bridges, buildings, roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
- Disciplines are surveying, master planning, environmental planning, and hazardous waste engineering, which are outside sbp's core interests.
- Clearly matches excluded categories such as pure urban/open space planning and environmental/feasibility-oriented services.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for a strategic planning study only, with no defined building program, quantities, or technical scope that would allow a realistic construction cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is a general consulting/planning assignment outside sbp's core structural scope, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice.
references_qualifications: Qualified and experienced consultants are requested; no specific minimum references, number of projects, or formal qualification thresholds are stated in the provided notice.

notes: Contract duration: 9. Questions deadline: 05/21/2026 05:00 PM MDT. Renewable: No. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Although categorized under general building in the source, the actual scope is a non-structural strategic infrastructure plan rather than a building design project.
